Playing Migos In A Kids’ Movie Is Crazy 😂🔥 

Migos Were One Of The Most Influential Rap Groups Of The 2010s, Consisting Of Quavo, Offset, And Takeoff. 🔥

The Atlanta Trio Helped Popularize The Modern Triplet Flow And Became One Of The Biggest Groups In Hip-Hop With Hits Like “Bad And Boujee,” “Versace,” “T-Shirt,” “Stir Fry,” And “Fight Night.” Their 2017 Album Culture Debuted At No. 1 On The Billboard 200, With “Bad And Boujee” Becoming Their First No. 1 Hit On The Billboard Hot 100. 🏆📈

Migos’ Influence Went Beyond Their Own Music — Their Distinctive Flow, Ad-Libs, Fashion, And Chemistry Had A Major Impact On The Sound And Culture Of Modern Trap. The Group Eventually Went Their Separate Ways, With Quavo And Offset Pursuing Solo Careers, While Takeoff’s Life Was Tragically Cut Short In 2022. 🕊️💔

Even Years Later, Migos’ Music And Influence Remain A Huge Part Of Hip-Hop Culture. 🐐🔥
